text_block_list.text: I came to the shrine with Twin Turbo, who hasn't been running well lately, but――

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's gonna draw an ema!
It's a challenge to God!
choice_data_list: You love a good challenge letter, don't ya?
You love challenge letters, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I love analog stuff like this!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: There's tons of fun stuff online to enjoy, but still~

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Because messages and accounts and stuff just vanish in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Online game friends... once you quit, that's really the end of it all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's why Turbo loves it!!
The ema, the challenge letter—and Tracen Academy too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I've got tons of people to send challenge letters to!

After talking cheerfully,
Twin Turbo began drawing on the ema—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Done! I wrote that I'm gonna win tons of races and blow God's mind!

Twin Turbo immediately jumped into action to make
what she drew a reality...
Afterward, she was back in top form!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. I didn't draw it
very well...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
When you write by hand,
there's no undo button, after all~...

Twin Turbo wasn't satisfied with how her ema turned out
and ended up feeling down...
